articles.title: Spring Roof Inspection Checklist for Homeowners
articles.excerpt: A practical homeowner checklist for spotting roof issues early and deciding when to call a professional.
articles.seoTitle: Spring Roof Inspection Checklist for Homeowners | Example Client
articles.metaDescription: Use this spring roof inspection checklist to catch small roof issues early, reduce repair costs, and know when to call a professional.

blocks.text: Inspect flashing, gutters, visible shingles, attic moisture, and drainage after winter. Document issues and schedule repairs before leaks spread. Repeat this spring roof inspection checklist after storms and seasonal weather changes so problems are found early.
Start with a visual ground check
Walk around the property and look for missing shingles, sagging lines, blocked gutters, and visible debris.
Pay close attention to flashing, valleys, roof penetrations, and previous repair areas.
Look for stains, mold, soft drywall, or attic condensation.
If you notice recurring leaks, storm damage, or structural movement, schedule a professional inspection.
